html:
Fiji won the first Olympic gold medal in rugby sevens at Rio de Janeiro in August 2016, beating Great Britain in the final. It was Fiji's first Olympic medal of any kind.

Rugby came with British soldiers and settlers around 1884 and became a national passion in villages, schools and the army. Fiji's fast, open style suited the seven-a-side game, and the team has long been among the world's best.

The win set off days of celebration and a national holiday, and a banknote was issued in the team's honour. Fiji won gold again in 2021. Fijian players fill professional teams in Europe, and their pay sent home matters to many families. See also Fiji, rugby union and the army, long a path for rugby players.
